summary: Amber International filed a Form 6-K with its Q4 & full-year 2025 unaudited results. Revenue surged 784.1% YoY to $66.1M; turns GAAP-profitable. No merger, tender, restructuring, activist, spin-off, or other special-situation event is announced. The filing is a routine earnings release by a foreign private issuer, with no corporate-action trigger. It also mentions a VARA VASP license and a new A-Suite platform but these are operational/strategic updates, not a formal special-situation event. No deal terms, no board recommendation, no advisor. The filing is purely an earnings report, not a special-situation filing.
